title: GeoProvenance capture event
description: DRAFT - NOT YET FROZEN. Emitted by geoprovenance/capture/normalizer.py, consumed by Person B's PROV mapper. Prose contract: docs/CONTRACT_event.md. Freezing procedure: RULES.md 3.1; change procedure after freezing: RULES.md 3.4.

session_id.description: Minted once at plugin startup. RULES.md 3.2 decision 5.

source.description: Which channel produced this. post_hook = the Processing post-execution hook; run_wrapper = the processing.run monkeypatch; history_signal = QgsHistoryProviderRegistry.entryAdded. Used for dedup (RULES.md 5.9) and for the RQ1 per-channel split (RULES.md 8.3).

ended_at.description: Null is legal for a cancelled run that never completed.

parameters.description: Scalar parameters only. Layer-valued parameters are lifted into inputs/outputs (RULES.md 3.3). Always JSON-serializable; the normalizer falls back to repr() rather than raising (RULES.md 5.5).

timestamp.description: Microsecond-precision UTC ISO 8601. RULES.md 3.2 decision 4 - second resolution collides with fingerprints UNIQUE(entity_id, computed_at).

param.description: The original QGIS parameter key, unmodified: INPUT, OUTPUT, OVERLAY.

path.description: NULL for memory:, TEMPORARY_OUTPUT and /vsimem/ layers. Person B MUST NOT attempt to fingerprint a null path (RULES.md 3.3).

format.description: From the provider/driver name, NOT the file extension - a .gpkg can hold vector or raster (RULES.md 5.8). Canonicalised to a stable name where the driver is recognised; reported verbatim where it is not.

crs.description: authid() such as EPSG:4326. WKT only when the CRS has no authid (RULES.md 5.7).

layer_type.description: Set even when path is null.

feature_count.description: Vectors only; null for rasters. Every key below is present on EVERY layer entry whatever its type, so Person B tests for null, never for presence.

band_count.description: Rasters only; null for vectors. Number of bands.

pixel_size.description: Rasters only; null for vectors. [x, y] ground units per pixel, in the layer's CRS. Null when either axis is unavailable or non-finite.

width.description: Rasters only; null for vectors. Width in pixels.

height.description: Rasters only; null for vectors. Height in pixels.
